sentiment.rationale: Management raised full-year 2025 revenue growth guidance to 18.5%-19.5% (from an initial scenario that implied lower growth), and EPS guidance to $4.55-$4.65, representing ~48% YoY growth. The guidance raise is organic, driven by strong client growth, NNA acceleration, and expense discipline, not attributed to one-time items. Management expresses high confidence ('our competitive position has never been stronger, and our confidence has never been higher'). The score is capped at +0.30 because the guidance raise is expressed as an updated scenario rather than a formal explicit raise, and some tailwinds (trading volumes, market levels) are macro-dependent.

summary.revenue: Q2 2025 total revenue of $5.9 billion, up 25% year-over-year.
summary.eps: Q2 2025 adjusted EPS of $1.14, up 56% year-over-year.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2025 revenue growth of 18.5%-19.5%, NIM of 2.65%-2.75%, expenses up 4.75%-5.25%, pretax margins in the very high 40s, and adjusted EPS of $4.55-$4.65 (excluding incremental buybacks).
summary.margin: Adjusted pretax profit margin of 50.1% for Q2 2025; full-year pretax margins expected in the very high 40s.
key_risks: Macroeconomic factors and market sentiment can change quickly, influencing client cash allocations and trading volumes.
Interest rate forward curve currently calls for two 25bp cuts before year-end, which could pressure NIM.
SEC reduced exchange processing fees to $0 beginning mid-May (though P&L neutral).
Client trading volumes may pull back in the second half.
key_opportunities: Core net new assets of $218 billion in H1 2025, up 39% YoY, with continued acceleration.
Managed investing net flows up 37% YoY; record flows for first half.
Spot trading in Bitcoin and Ethereum expected to launch, seen as a meaningful growth driver.
PAL originations up >100% YoY; lending balances growing.
40 AI use cases in development to drive efficiency and personalization.
Continued reduction of high-cost supplemental borrowings (down >70% from peak).

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management states 'our competitive position has never been stronger, and our confidence has never been higher' and describes the firm as 'playing offense' and 'well positioned to continue growing on all fronts.'
